title: Account Manager
description:
As Account Manager at Oxy, you'll own relationships with our key partners and customers — ensuring they get maximum value from our products and stay happy, engaged, and growing with us.

### What You'll Do

- Build and maintain strong relationships with Oxy's partners and enterprise customers.
- Serve as the primary point of contact for account health, renewals, and expansion.
- Understand customers' needs deeply and connect them with the right products and features.
- Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities that genuinely benefit the customer.
- Collaborate with support and product teams to resolve issues and improve the experience.
- Track and report on account health, engagement, and revenue metrics.

### What We're Looking For

- 2+ years in account management, customer success, or a related role.
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills.
- Proactive and customer-obsessed — you anticipate needs before they become problems.
- Comfortable with CRM tools and managing a portfolio of accounts.
- Alignment with Oxy's values and genuine enthusiasm for the products.

### Why Join Us

- Work with customers who are using technology built for good.
- Grow your career in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment.
- Remote-first with flexibility and a collaborative team culture.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
As Business Development Manager at Oxy, you'll identify and pursue strategic partnerships, new markets, and growth opportunities — helping us expand our reach and impact while staying true to our values.

### What You'll Do

- Develop and execute business development strategies to drive growth and new partnerships.
- Identify, qualify, and pursue strategic opportunities aligned with Oxy's mission and products.
- Build relationships with potential partners, investors, and ecosystem stakeholders.
- Lead negotiations and structure partnership agreements.
- Collaborate with product, marketing, and leadership teams to align BD efforts with company goals.
- Track and report on pipeline, deals, and growth metrics.

### What We're Looking For

- 3+ years in business development, partnerships, or corporate strategy.
- Proven track record of closing strategic deals and building partnerships.
- Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
- Strategic thinker who can connect long-term vision with near-term action.
- Genuine alignment with Oxy's mission of building ethical, open technology.

### Why Join Us

- Shape the strategic growth of a purpose-driven tech company.
- Work with a team that cares about doing things the right way.
- Remote-first with high autonomy and real ownership.

title: Community Manager
description:
As Community Manager at Oxy, you'll be the voice and heartbeat of our community. You'll grow and nurture our online presence across platforms, engage with users and contributors, and help build a community that genuinely reflects our values of openness, empathy, and collective care.

### What You'll Do

- Manage and grow Oxy's community presence across Telegram, Discord, social media, and forums.
- Engage authentically with community members — answering questions, sparking conversations, and highlighting contributions.
- Moderate community spaces to ensure a safe, inclusive, and welcoming environment.
- Organize and facilitate community events, AMAs, and online meetups.
- Collect community feedback and relay insights to the product and communications teams.
- Create regular community updates, newsletters, and content to keep members informed and engaged.

### What We're Looking For

- Experience managing online communities or social channels.
- Excellent written communication skills in English (Spanish a strong plus).
- Empathetic, patient, and skilled at de-escalation when needed.
- Familiar with platforms like Telegram, Discord, Twitter/X, and similar.
- Passion for ethical technology and open-source culture.
- Self-motivated and comfortable working async in a distributed team.

### Why Join Us

- Be the face of a community built around meaningful, ethical technology.
- Work with a team that genuinely cares about its users and contributors.
- Fully remote with real flexibility and ownership over your work.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll assist users through various channels, troubleshoot issues, maintain help articles, and gather feedback. Ideal candidates have customer support experience, excellent communication skills, and a passion for helping others, with a focus on ethical tech products.

Oxy builds ethical tech for real people — and real people sometimes need help. As our Customer Support Specialist, you'll be on the frontlines of that experience. You'll answer questions, solve problems, and guide users with clarity and empathy, ensuring they feel seen and supported every step of the way.

This is more than ticket resolution. It's about creating a support experience that reflects our values — human, ethical, and helpful.

### What You'll Do

- Respond to user questions and issues across chat, email, Telegram, and other channels.
- Troubleshoot basic product issues or guide users through steps clearly and patiently.
- Escalate bugs or technical issues to the relevant team, and follow up to ensure resolution.
- Maintain clear, user-friendly help articles and internal documentation using Notion or Intercom.
- Collect feedback and identify patterns to help improve our products and user flows.
- Help new users onboard smoothly and understand the value of our tools.

### What We're Looking For

- Previous experience in customer support, help desk, or user-facing roles.
- Excellent written communication skills — clear, calm, and kind.
- Comfortable learning and explaining digital tools (apps, web platforms).
- Familiarity with tools like Intercom, Notion, Slack, or Telegram is a plus.
- Empathetic, detail-oriented, and driven to help people.
- Fluent in English (Spanish or Catalan a bonus).

### Why Join Us

- Help users of ethical products that genuinely improve lives.
- Join a mission-driven team where support is seen as core to the experience — not an afterthought.
- Work async, remotely, and with a lot of trust and flexibility.
- Contribute to a culture of clarity, purpose, and collective care.
- Grow with a team that values your voice and your role in our ecosystem.

title: Data Analyst
description:
At Oxy, data isn't just numbers — it's a reflection of real people and real needs. As our Data Analyst, you'll work across teams to uncover insights that help us improve user experience, shape product strategy, and stay accountable to our mission of building ethical, human-first technology.

You'll support everything from product usage analytics and growth experiments to internal reporting and impact measurement — always with clean dashboards, clear thinking, and actionable output.

### What You'll Do

- Analyze product usage, user flows, and performance across mobile and web apps.
- Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using tools like Metabase, Superset, or Google Data Studio.
- Collaborate with product, design, and support teams to define KPIs and evaluate experiments.
- Work with raw data from sources like PostHog, MongoDB, APIs, or event logs and turn it into clean, interpretable datasets.
- Identify opportunities, surface insights, and tell stories that guide smart, ethical decisions.
- Support data integrity, documentation, and clarity across the org.

### What We're Looking For

- Experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, or BI Analyst in tech or startup settings.
- Strong skills in SQL, data wrangling, and creating dashboards for different audiences.
- Analytical mindset and ability to ask the right questions — not just crunch numbers.
- Familiarity with tools like PostHog, dbt, MongoDB, or basic Python (a plus).
- Clear communicator, good writer, and able to explain data to non-technical teammates.
- Deep alignment with Oxy's values around data ethics, privacy, and impact.

### Why Join Us

- Use data to help build better, fairer, and more transparent tech.
- Work in a remote-first, async-friendly culture where your voice matters.
- Contribute to tools that serve real people, not algorithms or ads.
- High ownership, fast learning, and space to shape your role and impact.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
As Graphic Designer at Oxy, you'll create visual assets that communicate our brand, values, and products across digital and print channels. From social media graphics to product illustrations and marketing materials, you'll help shape how the world sees Oxy.

### What You'll Do

- Design visual assets for social media, marketing campaigns, and product interfaces.
- Create illustrations, icons, and brand materials consistent with the Oxy visual identity.
- Collaborate with the communications and product teams to produce timely, on-brand content.
- Help evolve our brand guidelines and visual language.
- Prepare assets for both digital and print production.

### What We're Looking For

- A strong portfolio showcasing versatile graphic design work.
- Proficiency in tools like Figma, Adobe Illustrator, and Photoshop.
- Strong sense of typography, color, and layout.
- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in an async environment.
- Passion for ethical, purpose-driven design.

### Why Join Us

- Shape the visual identity of a growing ethical tech ecosystem.
- Work remotely with creative freedom.
- Be part of a mission-driven team building tech that matters.

title: HR Generalist
description:
As an HR Generalist at Oxy, you'll support the full employee lifecycle — from hiring and onboarding to culture-building and operations. You'll be a key pillar in building a team that reflects our values of empathy, diversity, and purpose.

### What You'll Do

- Support recruiting efforts: job postings, screening, scheduling, and coordinating interviews.
- Own the onboarding process and ensure new team members feel welcomed and set up for success.
- Maintain HR records, policies, and documentation in Notion.
- Support culture initiatives, team rituals, and inclusion efforts.
- Act as a trusted point of contact for team members on HR-related questions.
- Help shape and refine people operations as the team grows.

### What We're Looking For

- 2+ years in an HR, people ops, or recruiting role.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Empathetic communicator comfortable with sensitive conversations.
- Experience with remote teams and async work styles.
- Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, or HR platforms.

### Why Join Us

- Build people operations from the ground up at a mission-driven company.
- Work remotely with flexibility and real ownership of your domain.
- Help create a culture you're proud to be part of.

title: Internal Communications Coordinator
description:
As our Internal Communications Coordinator, you'll keep the Oxy team informed, aligned, and connected. You'll craft internal messaging, coordinate team updates, and help build a culture of transparency and clarity as we grow.

### What You'll Do

- Write and distribute internal updates, newsletters, and announcements.
- Coordinate async communication across teams using Slack, Notion, and email.
- Support leadership with all-hands meetings, town halls, and internal presentations.
- Develop and maintain a communications calendar for key internal milestones.
- Help strengthen our internal culture through consistent, clear messaging.

### What We're Looking For

- Experience in communications, content, or editorial roles.
- Excellent writing skills — clear, concise, and engaging.
- Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
- Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment.
- Familiarity with Slack, Notion, or similar tools.

### Why Join Us

- Play a foundational role in how our team communicates and stays aligned.
- Work with a distributed team that values transparency and openness.
- Fully remote with flexible hours and real ownership.

title: IT Support Specialist
description:
As IT Support Specialist at Oxy, you'll keep our team's tools, devices, and systems running smoothly. You'll be the go-to person for technical issues, onboarding new team members to our tech stack, and maintaining our internal IT operations.

### What You'll Do

- Provide first and second-line IT support to team members across devices, software, and accounts.
- Set up and configure laptops, tools, and access for new hires.
- Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls across our platforms.
- Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity issues in a remote environment.
- Maintain IT documentation and internal knowledge base articles.
- Identify recurring issues and propose improvements to our internal tooling.

### What We're Looking For

- Experience in an IT support, helpdesk, or sysadmin role.
- Comfortable supporting macOS and Linux environments.
- Familiarity with cloud tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, etc.).
- Strong communicator and patient problem-solver.
- Able to work independently in an async, remote-first setting.

### Why Join Us

- Keep a mission-driven team running at their best.
- Work remotely with full flexibility.
- Be part of something meaningful from the early stages.

title: Motion Graphics Designer
description:
As a Motion Graphics Designer at Oxy, you'll bring our brand and products to life through animated visuals, explainer videos, and dynamic content. You'll collaborate with design, product, and communications teams to produce motion content that reflects our values and resonates with our community.

### What You'll Do

- Design and produce motion graphics, animations, and video content for product, marketing, and social channels.
- Collaborate with the design team to maintain visual consistency across static and animated assets.
- Create explainer videos and onboarding animations that make our products easier to understand.
- Contribute to evolving the Oxy visual language through motion.
- Work async with a distributed team to deliver polished content on time.

### What We're Looking For

- Proven experience in motion design, animation, or video production.
- Proficiency in tools like After Effects, Lottie, Rive, or similar.
- Strong sense of timing, rhythm, and visual storytelling.
- Familiarity with UI/UX principles and how motion enhances product experiences.
- A portfolio showcasing a range of motion work.

### Why Join Us

- Shape the visual identity of a growing ethical tech ecosystem.
- Work remotely with creative freedom and a collaborative team.
- Contribute to products that genuinely matter to people.

title: Network Engineer
description:
As Network Engineer at Oxy, you'll design, implement, and maintain our network infrastructure — ensuring reliability, security, and performance across all our services and platforms.

### What You'll Do

- Design, configure, and maintain network infrastructure including LANs, WANs, VPNs, and cloud networking.
- Monitor network performance and proactively resolve issues before they impact users.
- Implement and maintain network security policies and access controls.
- Collaborate with the engineering team on infrastructure planning and scaling.
- Document network architecture, configurations, and procedures.

### What We're Looking For

- Solid experience in network engineering or administration.
- Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, and network security fundamentals.
- Experience with cloud networking (Cloudflare, AWS, DigitalOcean, or similar).
- Familiarity with VPNs, firewalls, and zero-trust network architectures.
- Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a remote environment.

### Why Join Us

- Build infrastructure that supports ethical, open-source technology at scale.
- Work with a technically curious and collaborative team.
- Remote-first with full flexibility.

title: Product Designer
description:
As Product Designer at Oxy, you'll own the end-to-end design process across one or more of our products — from early discovery and user research through to polished, production-ready interfaces. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to ensure every experience we ship is thoughtful, accessible, and aligned with our mission.

### What You'll Do

- Lead design for one or more Oxy products through the full product lifecycle.
- Conduct user research, define problems, and translate insights into design solutions.
- Produce wireframes, prototypes, flows, and high-fidelity UI ready for engineering handoff.
- Maintain and evolve our design system to ensure consistency across the ecosystem.
- Collaborate closely with engineers, PMs, and writers to deliver great experiences.
- Champion accessibility and inclusive design in everything you create.

### What We're Looking For

- A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work across web and/or mobile.
- Deep proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows.
- Experience conducting user research and translating findings into product improvements.
- Systems thinking — comfortable building and maintaining design systems at scale.
- Passion for ethical, human-first technology.
- Bonus: experience in fintech, housing, legal tech, or AI-driven products.

### Why Join Us

- Own design at a product level, not just execution.
- Work in a mission-driven environment where design decisions have real-world impact.
- Fully remote, async-first culture with a high degree of autonomy.

title: Product Manager
description:
At Oxy, we build ethical, human-first tools that solve real-world problems — and product is at the center of it all. As Product Manager, you'll help define the roadmap, prioritize features, and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver powerful, trustworthy solutions that users love.

You'll operate at the intersection of strategy and execution — balancing user needs, team capacity, and long-term vision with clarity and empathy.

### What You'll Do

- Own the product lifecycle for one or more products (e.g. Homiio, Sindi, Mention).
- Define product goals, user stories, priorities, and release plans in collaboration with the team.
- Turn high-level ideas into actionable specs and flows using tools like Notion, Linear, and Figma.
- Gather feedback from users, community, and stakeholders to inform iteration.
- Coordinate with engineers and designers to keep projects on track and aligned with Oxy's mission.
- Report on progress, blockers, and key decisions asynchronously and transparently.

### What We're Looking For

- Experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner in a tech or startup environment.
- Strong communication and organizational skills — clear, proactive, and async-friendly.
- Familiarity with agile practices and tools like Notion, Linear, GitHub, Figma, and Slack.
- Comfort managing technical conversations and understanding UX/dev tradeoffs.
- Alignment with Oxy's values — ethical, mission-driven, and people-focused.
- Bonus: experience in housing, legal tech, AI, or social impact platforms.

### Why Join Us

- Help shape the direction of products that actually make lives better.
- Work with a close-knit, cross-functional team that values autonomy and intention.
- Influence not just the "what" and "how," but the "why" behind everything we build.
- Remote-first culture, flexible hours, and high trust environment.

title: Project Manager
description:
As Project Manager at Oxy, you'll be the connective tissue between teams — aligning priorities, facilitating async collaboration, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, AI researchers, and founders to ensure deadlines are met, blockers are resolved, and everyone has what they need to deliver their best work.

### What You'll Do

- Coordinate projects across departments, setting clear timelines, task lists, and responsibilities using tools like Notion, Linear, GitHub, and Slack.
- Facilitate async communication, ensuring updates, decisions, and blockers are documented and resolved quickly.
- Support planning sessions, retrospectives, and regular check-ins with clarity and structure.
- Track progress and deadlines across multiple products in development (e.g. Homiio, Sindi, Mention).
- Keep documentation, timelines, and team pages organized and easy to follow.
- Identify inefficiencies or gaps and proactively propose solutions.

### What We're Looking For

- 2+ years experience in project or product coordination, preferably in a startup or remote tech team.
- Excellent organizational and communication skills, especially in async environments.
- Proficiency with project management tools like Notion, Linear, Trello, GitHub Projects, etc.
- A structured thinker who's calm under pressure and flexible in fast-changing settings.
- Bonus: familiarity with agile/scrum, or technical understanding of software development cycles.
- Strong alignment with Oxy's mission and a proactive, collaborative mindset.

### Why Join Us

- Help deliver products that create real-world impact, not vanity metrics.
- Join a small, mission-driven team where your work has direct influence and visibility.
- Shape how we plan, coordinate, and grow — from the ground up.
- Remote-first, async-friendly, with flexible hours and high autonomy.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
As Recruiting Coordinator at Oxy, you'll support the hiring process end-to-end — from posting roles and managing candidates to coordinating interviews and improving our talent pipeline. You'll help us attract people who share our values and want to build something meaningful.

### What You'll Do

- Post and manage job listings across platforms.
- Screen applications and coordinate initial outreach to candidates.
- Schedule and coordinate interviews across time zones.
- Maintain our applicant tracking system and ensure a smooth candidate experience.
- Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and team needs.
- Help build our employer brand and referral culture.

### What We're Looking For

- 1+ years in recruiting, talent acquisition, or HR coordination.
- Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
- Clear communicator — professional, warm, and timely.
- Comfortable with remote coordination across time zones.
- Familiarity with ATS tools, Notion, or Slack is a plus.

### Why Join Us

- Shape how we grow our team from early on.
- Work in a culture that genuinely values people and purpose.
- Remote-first with flexible scheduling.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
As Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Oxy, you'll be the first point of contact for potential customers and partners — identifying opportunities, sparking conversations, and building the pipeline that fuels our growth.

### What You'll Do

- Research and identify potential leads across target markets and verticals.
- Reach out to prospects via email, LinkedIn, and other channels to spark interest in Oxy's products.
- Qualify inbound leads and book discovery calls for senior team members.
- Maintain and update CRM records with accurate, timely information.
- Collaborate with marketing and sales to refine messaging and outreach strategies.
- Share feedback from prospecting to help improve positioning and targeting.

### What We're Looking For

- 1+ years in a sales, BDR, or SDR role (or strong motivation to break into sales).
- Excellent written communication — clear, personal, and persuasive.
- Curious, resilient, and comfortable with rejection.
- Organized and disciplined about pipeline management.
- Genuine interest in ethical technology and mission-driven work.

### Why Join Us

- Get in early at a growing startup and grow your sales career with us.
- Work on products you can genuinely be proud to represent.
- Remote-first with flexibility and real mentorship.

title: Sales Manager
description:
As Sales Manager at Oxy, you'll lead our sales efforts, build relationships with potential partners and customers, and help us grow revenue in a way that's aligned with our values. You'll be joining at an early stage with a lot of ownership and direct impact.

### What You'll Do

- Develop and execute sales strategies to drive growth across Oxy's product lines.
- Identify, prospect, and close new business opportunities with partners and customers.
- Build and manage a sales pipeline using CRM tools.
- Collaborate with product and marketing teams to align messaging and positioning.
- Report on sales performance and provide forecasts to leadership.
- Represent Oxy's mission authentically in every client interaction.

### What We're Looking For

- 3+ years in a sales or business development role, ideally in tech or SaaS.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- Self-driven and comfortable managing a pipeline independently.
- Genuine alignment with ethical tech and mission-driven work.
- Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).

### Why Join Us

- Shape the commercial foundation of a values-led tech company from the ground up.
- Work with a passionate team building products that make a real difference.
- Remote-first with flexible structure and high autonomy.

title: System Administrator
description:
As System Administrator at Oxy, you'll manage and maintain our server infrastructure, cloud environments, and internal systems — ensuring everything stays secure, stable, and scalable as we grow.

### What You'll Do

- Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure across DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, and related platforms.
- Monitor system health, performance, and uptime, responding to incidents proactively.
- Handle deployments, backups, and disaster recovery procedures.
- Manage access control, user provisioning, and security hardening.
- Automate routine operations using scripts and infrastructure-as-code tools.
- Document systems, runbooks, and procedures for the engineering team.

### What We're Looking For

- Solid experience as a sysadmin or DevOps/infrastructure engineer.
- Strong Linux skills and experience with cloud platforms (DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, AWS).
- Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
- Security-minded with hands-on experience in hardening servers and managing access.
- Self-directed, reliable, and comfortable in an async remote environment.

### Why Join Us

- Own and shape the infrastructure behind a growing ethical tech ecosystem.
- Work on meaningful products used by real people.
- Fully remote with high autonomy and trust.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
As a Technical Support Engineer, you'll provide technical assistance to users and internal teams, diagnosing and resolving complex product issues. You'll work closely with engineering to escalate bugs, document known issues, and contribute to a smoother user experience across the Oxy ecosystem.

### What You'll Do

- Investigate and resolve technical issues reported by users across our platforms.
- Reproduce bugs, document findings, and escalate to engineering with clear context.
- Create and maintain internal technical documentation and troubleshooting guides.
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to identify recurring issues and drive fixes.
- Assist in onboarding technical users and developers building on Oxy infrastructure.

### What We're Looking For

- Background in technical support, QA, or software engineering.
- Strong understanding of web technologies, APIs, and common debugging tools.
- Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical issues clearly for non-technical users.
- Experience with tools like Notion, Jira, Slack, or similar.
- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, async-first environment.

### Why Join Us

- Work on meaningful products at the intersection of open-source and ethical tech.
- Collaborate directly with the engineering team and have real impact on product quality.
- Remote-first, async-friendly culture with full flexibility.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bridge the gap between users and the product team, helping customers solve technical problems while feeding insights back to improve the platform. You'll be empathetic, resourceful, and comfortable with technical details.

### What You'll Do

- Handle incoming support requests with a mix of technical and general product questions.
- Guide users through troubleshooting steps across web, mobile, and API-related issues.
- Document resolutions and contribute to a growing knowledge base.
- Flag patterns and recurring issues to the product and engineering teams.
- Help test new features and provide feedback from a user's perspective.

### What We're Looking For

- 1+ years in a technical support or helpdesk role.
- Comfortable with web platforms, APIs, and basic debugging concepts.
- Strong written communication — clear, patient, and helpful.
- Proactive and able to work independently in a remote environment.
- Familiarity with Slack, Notion, or Intercom is a plus.

### Why Join Us

- Play a meaningful role in shaping the support experience for ethical tech products.
- Work flexibly and remotely with a collaborative, values-driven team.
- Grow your technical skills in a supportive and open environment.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
At Oxy, we're not building just another app — we're building an ecosystem of tools to make the world fairer, more connected, and more human. As our UX/UI Designer, you'll shape how people experience products like Homiio (ethical housing), Sindi (AI legal assistant), and Mention (a new kind of social network). You won't just design interfaces — you'll design trust, clarity, and impact.

### What You'll Do

- Design intuitive, beautiful, and accessible interfaces for web and mobile apps, from concept to final polish.
- Translate complex workflows into simple, human-centered journeys, especially in areas like housing, legal rights, or ethical commerce.
- Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that are ready for development.
- Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and writers to bring ideas to life.
- Contribute to and evolve our design system across the Oxy ecosystem.
- Advocate for user needs through research, testing, and thoughtful interaction design.

### What We're Looking For

- A strong portfolio showing polished UX/UI work across multiple platforms (especially mobile-first).
- Proficiency in Figma (or similar), with strong layout, typography, and design system skills.
- Experience in user research, A/B testing, and iterating based on feedback.
- Clear thinking and attention to detail — you know when to break rules and when to follow them.
- Passion for social good, tech ethics, and building products that solve real problems.
- Bonus if you have motion design or front-end dev knowledge.

### Why Join Us

- Design for purpose, not just profit — and see the direct impact of your work.
- Work with a passionate team across housing, AI, and ethical tech.
- Help define a product vision from the early stages, with a lot of ownership.
- Flexible, remote-first culture with async collaboration.
- Opportunity to grow into a lead role as we scale.
